mainTopic: Parts of a קרבן or a כהן outside the proper area, hanging in the air during שחיטה and קבלה, and blood put in the wrong place
overview: This amud finishes רבי אמי's ruling about a קרבן whose legs stick out past the edge of the עזרה. The גמרא rereads the ruling twice: first it is about cutting before or after קבלה, and then the cut goes only through the flesh down to the bone, so there is no בעל מום. The גמרא then tries to learn two rules from it: that blood soaked into the limbs counts as blood, and that meat of קדשים קלים leaving before זריקה is פסול. Both proofs are pushed off. A ברייתא about where קדשי קדשים and קדשים קלים are slaughtered and collected gives a new proof for the second rule, but that proof is pushed off too. Next, אבוה דשמואל questions שמואל about an animal partly outside the עזרה and about an animal or a person hanging in the air during שחיטה or קבלה, and he corrects most of שמואל's answers. אביי and רבא each sum up these hanging cases, and רבא's summary replaces אביי's. רבי זירא rules that a כהן must be fully inside, even his hair. A new משנה then teaches that blood put in the wrong place on the מזבח is פסול, but there is no כרת.

steps.title: Slaughtering first, then cutting, disqualifies the offering
steps.stepSummary: The end of רבי אמי's ruling: if he did the שחיטה first and only then cut off the legs, the קרבן is פסול.
steps.simpleTranslation: If he slaughtered the animal and only afterward cut off its legs, the offering is disqualified.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes quoting רבי אמי's rule about an animal whose legs are outside the עזרה. This line gives the bad order: שחיטה first, cutting second.
steps.deeperAnalysis: According to the explanation given here, blood from the legs, which are outside the עזרה, mixes into the blood that is collected. That makes the קרבן פסול. This line sets up the next step, because the other half of the rule, cutting first and then slaughtering, is about to be challenged.

keyTerms.meaning: He slaughtered (did the שחיטה)
He cut off
Disqualified (the offering is invalid)

phrases.english: If he slaughtered and afterward cut off the legs, it is disqualified.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes רבי אמי's statement from before this section.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Slaughtering and then cutting off the outside legs makes the קרבן פסול.

steps.title: Cutting first would make the animal blemished
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא attacks the first half of רבי אמי's rule, that cutting first and then slaughtering is כשרה: cutting the legs off before שחיטה means you are offering a בעל מום.
steps.simpleTranslation: If he cut off the legs and then slaughtered, is it really fit? He is offering a blemished animal!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the idea that cutting first and slaughtering second is fine. An animal missing its legs is a בעל מום, and a בעל מום cannot be brought as a קרבן.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The order 'cut, then slaughter' seemed to be the good way to do it. But cutting off a limb from a live animal gives it a blemish before the שחיטה even begins. So the rule cannot mean that.

keyTerms.meaning: Fit, valid
An animal with a blemish, which cannot be a קרבן
Offering, bringing as a קרבן

phrases.english: If he cut off the legs and afterward slaughtered, it is fit?!
He is offering a blemished animal!
phrases.notes: Once the legs are cut off a live animal, it is missing limbs, and that counts as a blemish.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the 'cut first' half of רבי אמי's rule.
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that cutting the legs before שחיטה gives a valid קרבן
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Cutting limbs off a live animal makes it a בעל מום, and a בעל מום is פסול for the מזבח.

steps.title: Reread the rule as being about the timing of קבלה
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא changes the reading: the order that matters is cutting compared to קבלה, the collecting of the blood, not compared to שחיטה.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, say this: if he cut off the legs and then collected the blood, it is fit. If he collected the blood and then cut off the legs, it is disqualified.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא fixes the problem by rereading רבי אמי's words. The שחיטה happened while the animal was fully inside, and the question is only whether he cut the legs before or after collecting the blood.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Now the cut happens after שחיטה, so the animal was not blemished when it was slaughtered. If he cuts before קבלה, the outside blood from the legs is not mixed in. If he collects first, blood from the legs that are outside gets into the collected blood, so it is פסול.

keyTerms.meaning: Rather, say: the גמרא is rereading the statement
He collected the blood (קבלה)

steps.confusionAlert: The words of רבי אמי are now read differently. 'Cut first' is no longer before שחיטה. It is after שחיטה but before collecting the blood.

phrases.aramaic: אֶלָּא אֵימָא: חָתַךְ וְאַחַר כָּךְ קִיבֵּל – כְּשֵׁרָה,
phrases.english: Rather, say: if he cut and afterward collected the blood, it is fit,
phrases.notes: The animal was already slaughtered while standing fully inside, and then its legs moved out past the edge.

phrases.english: if he collected and afterward cut, it is disqualified.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the בעל מום challenge by reinterpreting the case.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Rereading the wording of the statement (אלא אימא)
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The rule compared cutting to שחיטה.
steps.terutzMaskana: The rule compares cutting to קבלה, after a valid שחיטה.

steps.title: A blemish before קבלה also disqualifies, says רבי זירא
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges the new reading from רבי זירא: making a blemish after שחיטה but before קבלה also makes it פסול, based on a פסוק.
steps.simpleTranslation: If he cut and then collected, is it really fit? But רבי זירא said: if someone slits the ear of a בכור and afterward collects its blood, it is disqualified, as it says, 'And he shall take from the blood of the bull', meaning a bull that is just as it already was.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא attacks the new reading. רבי זירא teaches that the animal must still be unblemished at the time of קבלה, so cutting the legs before collecting should still be a problem.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Moving the cut to after שחיטה did not fully solve the problem. According to רבי זירא, the פסוק says the animal must be 'as it already was', without a blemish, when the blood is collected. Cutting off legs before קבלה gives it a blemish at that moment.

keyTerms.meaning: But didn't he say: introduces a contradicting source
One who slits the ear, making a blemish
A firstborn animal, brought as a קרבן
A bull as it already was, still unblemished

phrases.english: If he cut and afterward collected, it is fit?!
But didn't Rabbi Zeira say:
one who slits the ear of a firstborn animal,
phrases.notes: This is after the שחיטה. The knife nicks the ear and creates a blemish.

phrases.english: and afterward collected its blood, it is disqualified;
as it says: 'And he shall take from the blood of the bull',
a bull that is as it already was!
phrases.notes: Literally, 'a bull that already was.' The bull should be just as it was before, with no new blemish.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the reinterpretation from step 3.
steps.kashyaTarget: The new reading that cutting the legs before קבלה gives a valid קרבן
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: רבי זירא rules from a פסוק that a blemish created between שחיטה and קבלה makes the קרבן פסול, and cutting off legs is such a blemish.
steps.whyThisMatters: It shows that being free of blemishes matters not only at שחיטה but also at the time of קבלה.

steps.title: The cut only goes down to the bone
steps.stepSummary: רב חסדא in the name of אבימי explains that רבי אמי means cutting the flesh only until the bone, which is not a blemish.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב חסדא said in the name of אבימי: he cuts into the limb until he reaches the bone.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers רבי זירא's challenge. רבי אמי never meant cutting off the whole leg. He meant cutting the flesh down to the bone and leaving the bone whole.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Since the bone stays intact, the animal is not considered a בעל מום, so רבי זירא's rule does not apply. The cut is still enough to separate the outside blood before קבלה, so 'cut, then collect' remains כשרה.

keyTerms.meaning: Cuts into the limb, not all the way off
Until he reaches
Bone

steps.whatToRemember: רבי אמי's rule means this: after שחיטה, cut the flesh of the outside legs down to the bone, then collect the blood. That way there is no blemish and no outside blood. Collecting first and cutting after makes the קרבן פסול.

phrases.english: Rav Chisda said in the name of Avimi:
He cuts into the limb until he reaches the bone.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers רבי זירא's challenge by narrowing what 'cutting' means.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Narrowing the case: a partial cut that leaves the bone, not a full cut
steps.terutzHavaAmina: 'Cut' meant cutting the leg off completely, which is a blemish.
steps.terutzMaskana: 'Cut' means cutting only through the flesh to the bone, which is not a blemish.

steps.title: Trying to learn that blood soaked into the limbs counts as blood
steps.stepSummary: Based on רבי אמי's ruling that cutting after קבלה makes the קרבן פסול, the גמרא suggests we can learn that דם המובלע באברים counts as real blood.
steps.simpleTranslation: If he collected the blood and only then cut, it is פסול. Can we learn from this that blood absorbed in the limbs is considered blood?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא repeats רבי אמי's ruling as we now read it and tries to learn a new rule from it: blood soaked into the limbs counts as real blood.
steps.deeperAnalysis: After קבלה, the blood is already in the כלי, so why should cutting the legs (which were outside the courtyard) matter? The suggestion is that the blood still inside the legs counts as blood, and that blood left the courtyard, so the קרבן becomes פסול.

keyTerms.meaning: Can you learn from this? The גמרא is trying to draw a new rule from the ruling
Blood soaked into the limbs, not flowing freely
He did קבלה, collecting the blood in a כלי
He cut (here, cutting the legs)

steps.confusionAlert: The first line is not a new ruling. It is רבי אמי's ruling, read the way step 3 fixed it, repeated here as the starting point for a new inference.

phrases.english: If he collected the blood and afterwards cut, it is disqualified.
Can you learn from it:
that blood absorbed in the limbs is considered blood?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Now that רבי אמי's ruling is settled (steps 3 and 5), the גמרא tries to learn a new rule from it.
steps.raayaObject: Whether דם המובלע באברים counts as real blood
steps.raayaSupportSource: רבי אמי's ruling that cutting after קבלה makes the קרבן פסול

steps.title: Maybe the problem is the fat, not the blood
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא pushes off the proof: the קרבן may be פסול because of the fat in the legs, not because of the blood.
steps.simpleTranslation: Perhaps it is because of the fat.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא rejects the proof from step 6 by giving another reason the קרבן could be פסול.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The fat in the legs is part of the קרבן itself, so if it left the courtyard, that alone could make the קרבן פסול. So the ruling does not prove that soaked-in blood counts as blood.

keyTerms.meaning: Perhaps. Often used to push off a proof with another possibility
Fat or fatty matter in the animal's limbs

phrases.english: Perhaps it is because of the fat.
phrases.notes: He means the fat in the legs counts like the קרבן's own meat leaving the courtyard.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects step 6's attempted proof by offering another reason for the פסול.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects only the proof. It does not decide whether דם המובלע באברים counts as blood.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The פסול can be explained by the fat leaving the courtyard, so the blood need not be the reason.

steps.title: Trying to learn that קדשים קלים meat leaving before זריקה is פסול
steps.stepSummary: Building on the fat explanation, the גמרא suggests we can learn that meat of קדשים קלים that leaves before זריקת דם becomes פסול.
steps.simpleTranslation: Can we learn from this that meat of קדשים קלים that went out before the blood was sprinkled is פסול?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא accepts the fat explanation for now and tries to learn a different new rule from it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the fat leaving the courtyard makes the קרבן פסול, this happened before זריקה. Meat of קדשים קלים may be eaten outside after זריקה, so this would teach that leaving before זריקה still makes it פסול.

keyTerms.meaning: קרבנות of lesser holiness, whose meat may be eaten outside the courtyard
Sprinkling the blood on the מזבח
That went out (of the courtyard)

phrases.english: Can you learn from it:
meat of offerings of lesser sanctity
that went out before the sprinkling of the blood is disqualified?
phrases.notes: This is new because such meat may go out after the blood is sprinkled.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Uses step 7's fat explanation as the starting point for a second inference.
steps.raayaObject: Whether meat of קדשים קלים that leaves before זריקה becomes פסול
steps.raayaSupportSource: רבי אמי's ruling, explained by the fat leaving the courtyard before זריקה

steps.title: Maybe רבי אמי was talking about קדשי קדשים
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא pushes off the second proof: רבי אמי's case may involve קדשי קדשים, which may never be taken out, so nothing is learned about קדשים קלים.
steps.simpleTranslation: Perhaps it is about קדשי קדשים.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא rejects the proof from step 8 by limiting רבי אמי's case to קדשי קדשים.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Meat of קדשי קדשים must always stay in the courtyard, so it is obvious it becomes פסול when it leaves. If רבי אמי meant those קרבנות, his ruling tells us nothing new about קדשים קלים.

keyTerms.meaning: The holiest קרבנות, whose meat must be eaten inside the courtyard

steps.whatToRemember: Both rules the גמרא tried to learn from רבי אמי were pushed off. It is not clear whether the problem is the blood or the fat, and the case may be only about קדשי קדשים. So רבי אמי's ruling proves neither rule. Steps 10-11 try a new proof for the קדשים קלים question.

phrases.english: Perhaps it is with regard to offerings of the most sacred order.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects step 8's proof by limiting the case to קדשי קדשים.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects only the proof about קדשים קלים. The question itself stays open.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The proof assumes רבי אמי's case covers קדשים קלים, but it may be only about קדשי קדשים.

steps.title: A ברייתא on where קדשי קדשים must be slaughtered and collected
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא starts quoting a ברייתא as a new source for its question. The first half deals with קדשי קדשים, which must be slaughtered and collected in the north.
steps.simpleTranslation: The רבנן taught: קדשי קדשים are slaughtered in the north, and their blood is collected in a כלי שרת in the north. If the כהן stood in the south, reached his hand into the north and slaughtered, the שחיטה is valid. If he collected the blood that way, the קבלה is not valid. If he put his head and most of his body into the north, it counts as if all of him went in. If the animal jerked out to the south and came back, it is still valid.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is setting up a new proof by quoting the first half of a ברייתא. This half covers קדשי קדשים. The key line for the proof comes in the next half.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For קדשי קדשים, שחיטה done with only the hand in the north is fine, but קבלה needs the כהן himself in the north. Head and most of the body is enough to count as being there. An animal that jerks out of the north and comes back stays כשרה. Keep that last detail in mind, because the next half gives a different result for קדשים קלים.

keyTerms.meaning: Offerings of the highest holiness (like עולה and חטאת)
The northern part of the עזרה, where קדשי קדשים must be slaughtered
Collecting the blood of the קרבן in a vessel
A holy vessel used for the עבודה in the מקדש
The animal jerked or convulsed (after being slaughtered)

phrases.english: The Sages taught:
Offerings of the most sacred order: their slaughter is in the north,
and the collection of their blood in a service vessel is in the north.
If he stood in the south and stretched his hand into the north
and slaughtered, his slaughter is valid.
If he collected the blood, his collection is invalid.
phrases.notes: He means collecting in the same way, standing in the south with only his hand reaching north.

phrases.aramaic: הִכְנִיס רֹאשׁוֹ וְרוּבּוֹ – כְּאִילּוּ נִכְנַס כּוּלּוֹ.
phrases.english: If he put in his head and most of his body, it is as if all of him entered.
If it jerked, went out to the south and came back, it is valid.

steps.triggerLanguage: תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: קׇדְשֵׁי קָדָשִׁים – שְׁחִיטָתָן בַּצָּפוֹן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: The proof from רבי אמי was pushed off in step 9, so the גמרא turns to a new source for the same question.
steps.raayaObject: Whether meat of קדשים קלים that leaves before זריקה is פסול.
steps.raayaSupportSource: A ברייתא about where שחיטה and קבלה take place (first half: קדשי קדשים).

steps.title: קדשים קלים that jerk outside are פסול, so meat that leaves before זריקה is פסול
steps.stepSummary: The second half of the ברייתא says that a קדשים קלים animal that jerked outside the עזרה and came back is פסולה. The גמרא concludes from this that meat of קדשים קלים that leaves before זריקה is פסול.
steps.simpleTranslation: קדשים קלים are slaughtered inside the עזרה, and their blood is collected in a כלי שרת inside. If he stood outside, put his hand inside and slaughtered, the שחיטה is valid. If he collected the blood that way, the קבלה is invalid. Even if he put his head and most of his body inside, it counts as if he did not enter. If the animal jerked outside and came back, it is פסולה. So we learn that meat of קדשים קלים that left before זריקת דמים is פסול!
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא now covers קדשים קלים, and the גמרא draws its proof. The proof comes from the case of an animal that jerked outside and came back, which the ברייתא calls פסולה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The animal had already been slaughtered, but its blood had not yet been thrown. Its meat went outside the עזרה for a moment, and the ברייתא calls it פסולה. That looks like clear proof that meat of קדשים קלים that leaves before זריקה becomes פסול. This is the same question that steps 8 and 9 could not settle.

keyTerms.meaning: Offerings of lesser holiness (like שלמים), which may be slaughtered anywhere in the עזרה
Inside the עזרה
Outside the עזרה
Throwing the blood on the מזבח, the step that completes the קרבן
Learn from this (the גמרא draws a conclusion)

steps.confusionAlert: Do not mix up the two halves. For קדשי קדשים, the animal jerking out of the north was כשרה. For קדשים קלים, the animal jerking out of the עזרה was פסולה. The proof rests only on the second case.

phrases.english: Offerings of lesser sanctity: their slaughter is inside,
and the collection of their blood in a service vessel is inside.
If he stood outside and put his hand inside
and slaughtered, his slaughter is valid.
If he collected the blood, his collection is invalid;

phrases.aramaic: וְהִכְנִיס רֹאשׁוֹ וְרוּבּוֹ – כְּאִילּוּ לֹא נִכְנַס.
phrases.english: and if he put in his head and most of his body, it is as if he did not enter.
If it jerked, went outside and came back, it is invalid.
Learn from this: meat of offerings of lesser sanctity
that went out before the throwing of the blood is invalid!

steps.triggerLanguage: שְׁמַע מִינַּהּ: בְּשַׂר קָדָשִׁים קַלִּים שֶׁיָּצָא לִפְנֵי זְרִיקַת דָּמִים – פְּסוּלִים
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes the ברייתא begun in step 10 and draws the proof from its קדשים קלים section.
steps.raayaObject: Meat of קדשים קלים that leaves the עזרה before זריקה is פסול.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The ברייתא's case of a קדשים קלים animal that jerked outside and came back, which it calls פסולה.

steps.title: Maybe the ברייתא only means the parts burned on the מזבח
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא pushes off the proof. The ברייתא's פסול may refer only to the אליה, the יותרת הכבד and the two kidneys, which are burned on the מזבח.
steps.simpleTranslation: Perhaps the ברייתא is talking about the אליה, the יותרת הכבד and the two kidneys.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא rejects the proof from step 11. It says the ברייתא may only be calling certain parts of the animal פסול, not the regular meat.
steps.deeperAnalysis: These parts are burned on the מזבח and never belong outside the עזרה. So they may become פסול when they go out even for a moment. The regular meat of קדשים קלים may be different, so the question stays open.

keyTerms.meaning: The fat tail of a sheep, burned on the מזבח
The lobe attached to the liver (the diaphragm area), burned on the מזבח
The two kidneys, burned on the מזבח
Perhaps (used to push off a proof)

steps.whatToRemember: Both attempts to prove that קדשים קלים meat leaving before זריקה is פסול were pushed off: the one from רבי אמי and the one from this ברייתא. The question stays unresolved here.

phrases.english: Perhaps it is about the tail
and the diaphragm and the two kidneys.

steps.triggerLanguage: דִּילְמָא בְּאַלְיָה וְיוֹתֶרֶת הַכָּבֵד וּשְׁתֵּי כְלָיוֹת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the proof drawn in step 11 by narrowing what the ברייתא calls פסול.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Full rejection of the proof: the ברייתא may not be talking about regular meat at all.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The proof assumed the ברייתא meant the whole animal. It may mean only the parts burned on the מזבח, which may never leave the עזרה.

steps.title: An animal inside with its legs outside
steps.stepSummary: אבוה דשמואל asks שמואל what the law is when the animal is inside the עזרה but its legs are outside.
steps.simpleTranslation: שמואל's father asked שמואל: if the animal is inside and its legs are outside, what is the law?
steps.whatsHappening: A new question begins. אבוה דשמואל asks about an animal whose body is inside the עזרה while its legs stick out.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Until now the discussion was about the כהן's position and meat that goes out. Now the question is about the animal itself being partly outside. Is it treated as inside, or do the outside legs cause a problem? The answer comes next.

keyTerms.meaning: He asked him (introduces a question put to a teacher)
What is the law?

phrases.english: Shmuel's father asked Shmuel:
If it is inside and its legs are outside, what is the law?
phrases.notes: "It" is the קרבן animal, and "inside" means inside the עזרה.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After the proofs about קדשים קלים are pushed off, the גמרא opens a new question about an animal that is partly outside the עזרה.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Whether an animal with its body inside the עזרה and its legs outside is treated as fully inside.

steps.title: The whole animal must be inside
steps.stepSummary: שמואל answers that if the animal's legs are outside, it is פסולה. The פסוק 'והביאום לה׳' teaches that the entire animal must be inside.
steps.simpleTranslation: שמואל said to him: It is written, 'That they may bring them to ה׳.' This means the animal is not valid until all of it is inside.
steps.whatsHappening: שמואל answers his father's question from Step 13. If the animal's legs stick out of the עזרה, the שחיטה is not valid.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק speaks of bringing the animals 'to ה׳', meaning into the holy area. שמואל reads it as requiring the whole animal inside, not most of it. So even legs sticking out are enough to make it invalid.

keyTerms.meaning: 'And they shall bring them to ה׳‎' (ויקרא 17:5)
all of it, the entire animal
inside (the עזרה)

phrases.english: He (שמואל) said to him:
It is written: 'That they may bring them to ה׳'
meaning: not until all of it is inside.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question asked in Step 13.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The animal is פסולה unless it is entirely inside the עזרה, based on 'והביאום לה׳'.

steps.title: Slaughtering an animal hanging in the air
steps.stepSummary: His father asks about an animal that was hung up in the air and then slaughtered. שמואל says it is כשרה.
steps.simpleTranslation: If someone hung up the animal and slaughtered it, what is the law? שמואל said to him: It is valid.
steps.whatsHappening: אבוה דשמואל asks a new question: what if the animal was hanging in the air, not standing on the floor, when it was slaughtered? שמואל answers that it is valid.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Now the animal is fully inside, so the problem from Step 14 is gone. The new issue is whether hanging in the air matters. שמואל thinks it does not.

keyTerms.meaning: he hung up (the animal)
valid

phrases.english: If he hung up the animal and slaughtered it, what is the law?
He (שמואל) said to him: It is valid.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: A new question in the same series of questions from father to son.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Is a שחיטה valid if the animal was hanging in the air?

steps.title: The animal must be slaughtered on the side of the altar
steps.stepSummary: His father tells שמואל he is wrong. The שחיטה must be 'על ירך' the מזבח, and an animal hanging in the air does not meet this.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to him: You are mistaken. We need the slaughter to be on the side of the altar, and that is missing here.
steps.whatsHappening: אבוה דשמואל rejects שמואל's answer. A hanging animal is invalid.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The תורה says the animal is slaughtered 'on the side of the מזבח'. An animal hanging up in the air is not considered 'on the side', so the requirement is not met.

keyTerms.meaning: you are mistaken
on the side (of the מזבח)
and it is not there, the requirement is missing

phrases.english: He (his father) said to him: You are mistaken;
we need the slaughter to be on the side of the altar, and that is missing.
phrases.notes: This comes from ויקרא 1:11, 'on the side of the מזבח, to the north'.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects שמואל's answer in Step 15.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: שמואל's ruling that a hanging animal is כשרה.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: It ignores the requirement that the שחיטה be 'על ירך', on the side of the מזבח.

steps.title: The slaughterer is hanging in the air
steps.stepSummary: His father asks about a person who was hanging in the air while slaughtering an animal standing normally. שמואל says it is פסולה.
steps.simpleTranslation: If the slaughterer was hanging in the air and slaughtered, what is the law? שמואל said to him: It is invalid.
steps.whatsHappening: Now the case is flipped: the animal is on the ground, but the person slaughtering is hanging in the air. שמואל says it is invalid.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The word changes from תלה ('he hung up the animal') to נתלה ('he himself was hanging'). שמואל seems to apply the lesson he just learned to the person as well.

keyTerms.meaning: he himself was hanging (in the air)
invalid

steps.confusionAlert: Watch the small change in wording. תָּלָה means the animal was hung up; נִתְלָה means the person was hanging.

phrases.english: If he (the slaughterer) was hanging and slaughtered, what is the law?
He (שמואל) said to him: It is invalid.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: The opposite case: now the person is in the air, not the animal.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Is a שחיטה valid if the slaughterer is hanging in the air?

steps.title: Only the slaughter must be on the side, not the slaughterer
steps.stepSummary: His father says שמואל is wrong again. The rule of 'על ירך' applies to the שחיטה, not to the person doing it.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to him: You are mistaken. The slaughter must be on the side of the altar, but the one slaughtering does not need to be on the side.
steps.whatsHappening: אבוה דשמואל rejects the answer. A slaughterer hanging in the air is fine.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The requirement is about where the שחיטה happens, meaning where the animal is. Since the animal is in the right place, it does not matter where the person's body is.

keyTerms.meaning: the one who slaughters

phrases.english: He (his father) said to him: You are mistaken;
the slaughter must be on the side of the altar,
but not the one who slaughters on the side of the altar.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects שמואל's answer in Step 17.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: שמואל's ruling that a hanging slaughterer makes it פסולה.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The 'על ירך' rule is about the שחיטה (the animal), not the person slaughtering.

steps.title: Collecting the blood while hanging in the air
steps.stepSummary: His father asks about a כהן who was hanging in the air while he did קבלה, collecting the blood. שמואל says it is כשרה.
steps.simpleTranslation: If he was hanging in the air and collected the blood, what is the law? שמואל said to him: It is valid.
steps.whatsHappening: The next question moves from שחיטה to קבלה: a כהן hanging in the air collects the blood. Following the lesson he just learned, שמואל says it is valid.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Step 18 taught that the person's position does not matter for שחיטה. שמואל assumes the same is true for קבלה.

keyTerms.meaning: he collected (the blood in a כלי)

phrases.english: If he was hanging and collected the blood, what is the law?
He (שמואל) said to him: It is valid.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Applies the same question to קבלה instead of שחיטה.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Is קבלה valid if the כהן is hanging in the air?

steps.title: Hanging in the air is not a normal way to serve
steps.stepSummary: His father says שמואל is wrong. Collecting blood while hanging is not the normal manner of עבודה, so it is invalid.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to him: You are mistaken. This is not the normal way of doing the service.
steps.whatsHappening: אבוה דשמואל rejects the answer. A כהן who collects blood while hanging in the air does not do a valid קבלה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For שחיטה, the 'על ירך' rule was about the slaughter and not the slaughterer, so the person's position did not matter (step 18). קבלה has a different requirement: it must be done in the normal way of service. A כהן hanging in the air is not serving in the normal way.

keyTerms.meaning: the normal way of doing the עבודה
in this way

steps.whatToRemember: The animal must be fully inside the עזרה. It must also be on the side of the מזבח, not hanging, during שחיטה. The slaughterer may hang in the air, but a כהן doing קבלה may not, because that is not the normal way of serving. The next steps add the last case, an animal hanging during קבלה.

phrases.english: He (his father) said to him: You are mistaken;
this is not the normal way of serving.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects שמואל's answer in Step 19. One more question in the series follows in step 21.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: שמואל's ruling that קבלה by a hanging כהן is כשרה.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: קבלה must be done in the normal manner of service, and hanging in the air is not normal.

steps.title: Animal hanging while the blood is collected
steps.stepSummary: His father asks about an animal that was hung in the air while its blood was collected. שמואל says it is פסולה.
steps.simpleTranslation: If he hung up the animal and collected its blood, what is the law? שמואל said to him: It is invalid.
steps.whatsHappening: שמואל's father asks one more case. This time the animal is hanging in the air during קבלה, the collecting of the blood. שמואל answers that it is פסולה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This case is the opposite of step 19. There the כהן was hanging, and here the animal is hanging. שמואל seems to reason that if a hanging animal ruins the שחיטה (step 16), it also ruins the קבלה.

keyTerms.meaning: He hung up the animal, so the animal is the one in the air
He collected the blood (from the word קַבָּלָה)
What is the law?
Invalid, disqualified

phrases.english: If he hung up the animal and collected the blood, what is the law?
He said to him: It is invalid.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: The next question in the father's series. It flips step 19 by having the animal hang instead of the כהן.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Is the קבלה valid if the animal hangs in the air while its blood is collected?

steps.title: The 'side of the altar' rule covers only שחיטה
steps.stepSummary: His father tells שמואל he is wrong. The Torah's rule of 'על ירך' applies to the שחיטה, not to the קבלה.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to him: You are mistaken. The slaughter must be on the side of the altar, but the collecting of the blood does not have to be on the side of the altar.
steps.whatsHappening: שמואל's father rejects his answer. The 'על ירך' requirement belongs only to שחיטה, so a hanging animal does not ruin the קבלה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In step 16 a hanging animal was פסול because the שחיטה has to be 'על ירך'. The father now limits that rule to שחיטה alone. Since nothing similar is required for קבלה, collecting blood from a hanging animal is fine.

keyTerms.meaning: You are mistaken
On the side of the מזבח, the place the Torah sets for the שחיטה
Slaughtering the animal
Collecting the blood in a vessel

phrases.english: He said to him: You are mistaken;
the slaughter must be on the side of the altar,
phrases.notes: This refers back to the פסוק about slaughtering 'על ירך המזבח' (ויקרא 1:11).

phrases.english: but the collecting of the blood need not be on the side of the altar.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects שמואל's answer in step 21.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: שמואל's ruling that a hanging animal ruins the קבלה.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: שמואל stretched the 'על ירך' rule from שחיטה to קבלה, but the rule applies only to שחיטה.

steps.title: אביי sums up the hanging cases
steps.stepSummary: אביי sums up all the cases. In קדשי קדשים every case is פסול except a person hanging while slaughtering. In קדשים קלים every case is כשר except a person hanging while collecting the blood.
steps.simpleTranslation: אביי said: With offerings of the most sacred order, all the cases are invalid, except where the person was hanging and slaughtered. With offerings of lesser sanctity, all the cases are valid, except where the person was hanging and collected the blood.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי gathers all the cases from this discussion into one summary. He sets out a separate rule for קדשי קדשים and for קדשים קלים.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For קדשי קדשים, אביי seems to hold that the air above the north side does not count as the north, so almost any hanging is פסול. The one exception is a person hanging while slaughtering, because the 'על ירך' rule applies to the שחיטה, not to the person doing it. For קדשים קלים, which have no north requirement, everything is כשר except a hanging person doing קבלה, which is not the normal way to do the עבודה.

keyTerms.meaning: Offerings of the most sacred order, which must be slaughtered in the north of the עזרה
Offerings of lesser sanctity, which may be slaughtered anywhere in the עזרה
He was hanging, so the person is the one in the air
Except for

steps.confusionAlert: Watch the two similar words. תָּלָה means he hung up the animal, so the animal is in the air. נִתְלָה means the person himself was hanging in the air. The whole summary depends on telling them apart.

phrases.english: אביי said:
With offerings of the most sacred order, all of them are invalid,
except where he was hanging and slaughtered.
With offerings of lesser sanctity, all of them are valid,
except where he was hanging and collected the blood.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר אַבָּיֵי: בְּקׇדְשֵׁי קָדָשִׁים – כּוּלָּן פְּסוּלוֹת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: After the father's series of answers, אביי sorts all the cases into one rule for each type of קרבן.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: In קדשי קדשים, all hanging cases are פסול except נתלה ושחט. In קדשים קלים, all are כשר except נתלה וקיבל.

steps.title: רבא: if the air counts as inside, the air should count as north too
steps.stepSummary: רבא asks why אביי treats an animal hanging during קבלה differently in the two types of קרבן. If the air in the עזרה counts as inside the עזרה, the air above the north side should count as north.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבא said: Why is a case where he hung up the animal and collected the blood valid with offerings of lesser sanctity? Because the air inside the courtyard is considered like inside. Then with offerings of the most sacred order too, the air in the north should be considered like the north!
steps.whatsHappening: רבא challenges אביי's summary. He points out that the case of an animal hanging during קבלה is treated differently in the two types of קרבן, with no good reason.
steps.deeperAnalysis: According to אביי, an animal hanging during קבלה is כשר in קדשים קלים, which must mean the air in the עזרה counts as being inside it. But in קדשי קדשים אביי made the same case פסול. רבא argues that by the same logic, the air above the north side should count as the north, so it should be כשר there too.

keyTerms.meaning: What is different? Used to challenge an unequal ruling
Air, the space above the ground
Inside, meaning within the עזרה
The north side of the עזרה, where קדשי קדשים are slaughtered
Is considered like, is equal to

phrases.english: רבא said:
What is different about where he hung up the animal and collected the blood
with offerings of lesser sanctity, that it is valid?
Because the air inside the courtyard is considered like inside?
phrases.notes: רבא is spelling out the reason אביי must be relying on.

phrases.english: Then with offerings of the most sacred order as well,
the air in the north should be considered like the north!

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רָבָא: מַאי שְׁנָא תָּלָה וְקִיבֵּל
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks the inconsistency inside אביי's summary from step 23.
steps.kashyaTarget: אביי's ruling that תלה וקיבל is פסול in קדשי קדשים but כשר in קדשים קלים.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If the air of the עזרה counts as inside for קדשים קלים, then the air of the north should equally count as north for קדשי קדשים.

steps.title: רבא's own summary of the hanging cases
steps.stepSummary: רבא rules that everything is כשר in both types of קרבן with two exceptions. An animal hanging during שחיטה is פסול in קדשי קדשים, and a person hanging during קבלה is פסול in both types.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, רבא said: With both offerings of the most sacred order and offerings of lesser sanctity, they are valid. The exceptions are where he hung up the animal and slaughtered it, with offerings of the most sacred order, and where he was hanging and collected the blood, with both offerings of the most sacred order and offerings of lesser sanctity.
steps.whatsHappening: Having rejected אביי's summary, רבא gives his own. Almost every case is כשר, and he names just two exceptions.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Each exception has its own source. An animal hanging during שחיטה breaks the 'על ירך' rule from step 16, and רבא applies that rule only to קדשי קדשים. A person hanging during קבלה is not doing the עבודה in the normal way (step 20), and that is true for every קרבן. Everything else is כשר, because the air of the north counts as the north.

keyTerms.meaning: Rather, introducing a new approach after rejecting the old one
Both this and that
Valid, acceptable

steps.whatToRemember: According to רבא, hanging in the air is a problem in only two cases. The first is an animal hanging during שחיטה of קדשי קדשים, because of 'על ירך'. The second is a כהן hanging during קבלה in any קרבן, because that is not the normal way to do the עבודה.
steps.whyThisMatters: רבא's summary shows that each exception has a different source. One comes from a פסוק that applies only to קדשי קדשים, and the other from a general rule about how עבודה must be done. That difference is why one exception covers only קדשי קדשים and the other covers every קרבן.

phrases.english: Rather, רבא said:

phrases.aramaic: בֵּין בְּקׇדְשֵׁי קָדָשִׁים בֵּין בְּקָדָשִׁים קַלִּים – כְּשֵׁרוֹת;
phrases.english: Both with offerings of the most sacred order and with offerings of lesser sanctity, they are valid;

phrases.aramaic: בַּר מִן תָּלָה וְשָׁחַט – בְּקׇדְשֵׁי קָדָשִׁים,
phrases.english: except where he hung up the animal and slaughtered it, with offerings of the most sacred order,
and where he was hanging and collected the blood,

phrases.aramaic: בֵּין בְּקׇדְשֵׁי קָדָשִׁים בֵּין בְּקָדָשִׁים קַלִּים.
phrases.english: both with offerings of the most sacred order and with offerings of lesser sanctity.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֶלָּא אָמַר רָבָא: בֵּין בְּקׇדְשֵׁי קָדָשִׁים בֵּין בְּקָדָשִׁים קַלִּים
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Replaces אביי's summary from step 23, based on רבא's challenge in step 24.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: Everything is כשר except תלה ושחט in קדשי קדשים and נתלה וקיבל in all קרבנות.

steps.title: A כהן inside whose hair sticks outside
steps.stepSummary: רבי ירמיה asks רבי זירא about a כהן who is inside the עזרה while his locks of hair stick outside.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי ירמיה asked רבי זירא: if the כהן is inside but his locks of hair are outside, what is the law?
steps.whatsHappening: The previous steps asked about someone hanging in the air. Now רבי ירמיה asks a new question: is a כהן counted as "inside" if only part of him, his hair, reaches outside?
steps.deeperAnalysis: The question is whether the whole body of the כהן must be inside the עזרה, or whether it is enough that his body is mostly inside. Hair is a very small part of the body, so it is a good test case.

keyTerms.meaning: He asked him (a real question)
His locks of hair (not the strings on a garment)
Inside / outside (the עזרה)
What is the law?

steps.confusionAlert: צִיצִית here does not mean the strings on a four-cornered garment. It means the locks of hair on the כהן's head.

phrases.aramaic: בְּעָא מִינֵּיהּ רַבִּי יִרְמְיָה מֵרַבִּי זֵירָא:
phrases.english: Rabbi Yirmeya asked Rabbi Zeira:
If he is inside and his locks are outside, what is the law?
phrases.notes: "His locks" means the hair on his head, not the strings of a garment.

steps.triggerLanguage: בְּעָא מִינֵּיהּ רַבִּי יִרְמְיָה מֵרַבִּי זֵירָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves from the hanging-in-the-air cases to a new question: a כהן who is only partly inside.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Does a כהן count as inside the עזרה if part of him, his hair, is outside?

steps.title: The כהן must be fully inside
steps.stepSummary: רבי זירא answers that just as a קרבן must be entirely inside, the כהן must be entirely inside, based on the פסוק "בבואם אל אהל מועד".
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to him: didn't you say that "And they shall bring them to ה׳" means the animal must be entirely inside? Here too, "When they come into the אהל מועד" means the כהן must be entirely inside the אהל מועד.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי זירא answers the question. He compares the כהן to the animal: both must be completely inside.
steps.deeperAnalysis: There is already a known rule from "וֶהֱבִיאוּם לַה׳" that a קרבן must be completely inside when it is brought. רבי זירא uses a similar פסוק about the כהנים, "בְּבוֹאָם אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד", to say the same rule applies to the כהן himself. So even his hair sticking out makes him not fully inside.

keyTerms.meaning: Didn't you say? (reminding him of a known rule)
"And they shall bring them to ה׳"
All of it / all of him
Here too
The Tent of Meeting

steps.whatToRemember: A כהן doing the עבודה must be entirely inside, just as the קרבן must be entirely inside. Even his hair cannot stick out.

phrases.english: He said to him: Did you not say
"And they shall bring them to the Lord"
that it is not valid until all of it comes inside?
phrases.notes: "It" is the animal. A קרבן counts only when all of it is inside.

phrases.english: Here too, "When they come into the Tent of Meeting"
phrases.notes: שמות 28:43. This פסוק is about the כהנים.

phrases.english: means not until all of him comes into the Tent of Meeting.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers רבי ירמיה's question directly.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The כהן must be entirely inside. Just as the animal must be fully inside, the כהן must be fully inside.

steps.title: משנה: blood placed in the wrong spot
steps.stepSummary: The משנה lists cases where blood was put in the wrong place: on the ramp, not above the base, above instead of below, below instead of above, outside instead of inside, or inside instead of outside. All are פסול, but there is no כרת.
steps.simpleTranslation: If he put the blood on the ramp, or on a part of the altar that is not above the base, or he put blood that belongs below up high, or blood that belongs up high down below, or blood that belongs inside outside, or blood that belongs outside inside, the offering is disqualified, but there is no כרת.
steps.whatsHappening: A new משנה begins. It lists six ways the כהן can put the blood in the wrong spot, and it rules that all of them make the קרבן פסול.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Each blood placement has its proper spot. Some go on the lower half of the מזבח, some on the upper half, some on the outer מזבח, and some inside the היכל. Putting blood in the wrong spot ruins the קרבן. The משנה adds one limit: even so, these cases do not carry the punishment of כרת.

keyTerms.meaning: The ramp leading up to the מזבח
The base along the bottom of the מזבח
The blood placements that are supposed to be put (in a certain place)
Below / above (the middle line of the מזבח)
Disqualified
A heavenly punishment of being cut off

steps.whatToRemember: Putting the blood in the wrong place makes the קרבן פסול, but it does not bring כרת.
steps.whyThisMatters: This משנה teaches that every blood placement has its proper spot on the מזבח, and changing the spot ruins the קרבן.

phrases.english: MISHNA: If he put it on the ramp;
phrases.notes: "It" is the blood. The ramp is the slope the כהנים walk up to reach the מזבח.

phrases.english: or not opposite the base;
or he put the blood meant to be put below, above;
or the blood meant to be put above, below;
or the blood meant to be put inside, outside;
or the blood meant to be put outside, inside —
it is disqualified, and there is no karet for it.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new משנה. It moves from where the כהן stands to where the blood is put.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Blood put in the wrong place makes the קרבן פסול, but there is no כרת.
